field_evidence: Official register proposal explicitly identifies removal of the existing outbuilding/log store and erection of one annexe ancillary living-space structure. Proposed Block Plan DWG No. 08-00, Proposed Outbuilding Sections DWG No. 06-02, Proposed Annexe Floor Plan DWG No. 05-03, and Proposed Outbuilding Elevations DWG No. 07-00 support the same single distinct planned structure. Existing structures marked for removal are not counted as planned-building progress.
